title: What is Classification in Machine Learning? Fundamentals and Applications

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this new section on classification.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到分類的新章節。

cues.en: Very exciting.
cues.zh: 很令人期待。

cues.en: Classification is a very popular and important tool in machine learning, so I'm super excited to get started.
cues.zh: 分類是機器學習中常見而重要的工具，很期待開始。

cues.en: Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 看看吧。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So classification can be defined as a machine learning technique to identify the category of new observations based on training data.
cues.zh: 分類可以定義為：根據訓練資料，判定新觀測值所屬類別的機器學習技術。

cues.en: This is different to regression where we had to predict a continuous number.
cues.zh: 不同於迴歸預測連續數值。

cues.en: Here we use classification to predict a category.
cues.zh: 分類預測的是類別。

cues.en: Another important thing is that it's a type of supervised learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 另一個重點，它屬於監督式學習。

cues.en: We'll discuss this a bit more when we reach the next section on clustering.
cues.zh: 下一部分分群時，會再多談一些。

cues.en: And there are actually a variety of applications of classification from medicine to marketing to business and lots of different areas.
cues.zh: 分類的應用很多，從醫療、行銷、商業到各個領域。

cues.en: Let's have a look at a few.
cues.zh: 看幾個例子。

cues.en: So for example, you have customers of a business and you would like to predict which ones are likely to stay and which ones are likely to leave.
cues.zh: 例如企業想預測哪些顧客會留下，哪些可能流失。

cues.en: This is also called churn modeling.
cues.zh: 這也稱為顧客流失建模。

cues.en: Very important because if you can predict which customers are likely to leave your business in the next month or six months, then you can take actions and send them special offers
cues.zh: 非常重要。如果能預測未來一個月或六個月會離開的顧客，就能採取行動，提供特別優惠，

cues.en: or ask them about their feedback and make certain changes so that they stay.
cues.zh: 或詢問意見、做出調整，讓他們留下。

cues.en: So it's a very powerful tool for businesses.
cues.zh: 因此是企業的強大工具。

cues.en: Another application is email.
cues.zh: 另一個應用是電子郵件。

cues.en: So for instance, if you get an email, it might be classified as normal mail or it might be classified as important, an urgent mail, it might have a special marker, especially if using Gmail
cues.zh: 收到郵件後，可能分類為一般、重要或緊急郵件，並加上特別標記。尤其使用 Gmail 時，

cues.en: you'll see those little chevrons or triangles at the beginning of a message saying that it's important.
cues.zh: 訊息前面會看到小箭頭或三角形，表示重要。

cues.en: Or it might be categorized as a promotion and it might be put into a separate folder so it's not filling up your main inbox which you use for work, or it might be categorized as spam.
cues.zh: 也可能分類為促銷，移到另一個資料夾，避免塞滿工作用收件匣；或分類為垃圾郵件。

cues.en: So spam filters have become very good over the past few years.
cues.zh: 近幾年垃圾郵件過濾已經很進步。

cues.en: We barely see any spam in our inboxes and that is thanks to classification algorithms.
cues.zh: 收件匣幾乎看不到垃圾信，這都要歸功於分類演算法。

cues.en: And another application is image recognition.
cues.zh: 另一個應用是影像辨識。

cues.en: So for instance, here we have images of dogs and cats.
cues.zh: 例如這裡有狗與貓的圖片。

cues.en: Classification would be able to separate dogs from cats.
cues.zh: 分類模型能將狗與貓區分開。

cues.en: So those are just a few examples.
cues.zh: 這只是幾個例子。

cues.en: As you can see, it's a very powerful tool.
cues.zh: 如你所見，是很強大的工具。

cues.en: There are lots of algorithms that fall into this family of classification in machine learning and they have a variety of applications.
cues.zh: 機器學習的分類家族包含很多演算法，應用十分廣泛。

cues.en: So I'm very excited to explore this section further with you together and until next time, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 很期待和你深入探索這一節。下次見，享受機器學習吧。
